# YourPods

> YourPods is a gPodder-compatible, privacy-first, self-hosted podcast player for iOS, macOS, watchOS, and Apple Watch — built natively in Swift and SwiftUI. Sync your subscriptions and listening progress across all your devices using your own Nextcloud server. Version 26.8.0.

## Versioning

Versions follow a calendar scheme, `yy.mm.vv` — year, month, and the release's index within that month. It supersedes the 2.0.x semver line as of August 2026; 26.8.0 is what 2.0.5 would have been.

## Licensing & Cost

gPodder sync, Nextcloud sync, and local Vault Mode are subscription-free and always will be. There is no account to create and no feature behind a paywall on the self-hosted path. YourPods separately offers an optional hosted account, YourPods Cloud: a free tier (subscriptions and listen positions) and a paid YourPods Pro tier (web player, cross-device Up Next handoff, notes sync). Pricing is on the App Store listing only. The app itself is GPLv3.

## Core Features

- **Native Apple App**: Built in Swift 5.10 and SwiftUI, targeting iOS 18+, macOS 14+, watchOS 10+, and with native CarPlay integrations.
- **Privacy**: No tracking, analytics, or ads. Fully self-hosted sync via Nextcloud/gPodder.
- **P3 (Privacy Preserving Playback)**: Strips 39 tracking prefixes covering 25 analytics services from episode URLs before playback, from a bundled snapshot of the OPAWG public prefix registry plus a curated supplement. Matched by host, so a tracker changing its URL shape doesn't defeat it. Also strips `utm_*` and AdsWizz attribution parameters while leaving signed playback parameters intact. Dynamic ad-insertion URLs (Megaphone, AdsWizz) are deliberately passed through untouched — P3 is a privacy tool, not an ad blocker. Enable globally or per-podcast. Green shield icon on Now Playing when active.
- **Episode Notes**: Timestamped notes at any point in an episode, with colours and tags, anchored optionally to a chapter or a transcript line. Browsable and filterable from the Library. Free for all users on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
- **Notes Export**: Markdown file with YAML frontmatter, Obsidian vault (per-episode note, daily-note append, or share sheet), or your own Nextcloud (Markdown files or real Nextcloud Notes, filed by podcast).
- **Localization**: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, and Dutch — over 1,080 strings translated per language, covering the app, Apple Watch, widgets, Live Activity, complication, Siri phrases and replies, and VoiceOver. Follows the per-app language set in iOS/macOS Settings; no in-app picker.
- **New Episode Notifications**: Local push notifications when background refresh discovers new episodes. Per-podcast controls. 100% local — no push servers.
- **Hidden Episodes**: Hide episodes to declutter feeds without affecting listening stats. Batch-hide old episodes. Hidden state syncs across devices.
- **Podcast Groups**: Organize subscriptions into named folders. Bulk-move shows. Browse groups in CarPlay.
- **Multi-Profile**: Switch between different servers or user accounts instantly. Local-only accounts (Vault Mode) supported.
- **Sync Conflict Management**: Smart conflict resolution with options to keep local state or overwrite from server.
- **Last Synced Timestamp**: Displays the last sync time in settings for transparency.
- **Cross-Device Sync**: Subscriptions, listening positions, played state, and hidden episodes sync via your gPodder server automatically, with per-episode version checks so two devices can't overwrite each other's position. The gPodder protocol does not carry a queue, so Up Next stays per-device on a self-hosted server; cross-device Up Next handoff is a YourPods Pro feature.
- **Sign in with Nextcloud**: Browser-based Nextcloud Login Flow v2 instead of manually created app passwords, with one-tap re-authentication when access expires. Manual app-password entry remains available.
- **Share Links**: Share an episode, a podcast, or the current playback position as a share.yourpods.app link, minted with Apple device attestation (App Attest on iOS/iPadOS, DeviceCheck on macOS) so no account is required. Opening a link resolves to the episode, or to a preview sheet with Play, Add to Queue, and Follow Show.
- **OPML Import & Export**: Migrate subscriptions to or from other apps, or back up your library. Enriched export preserves Podcast Groups and Listening Profiles.
- **Password-Protected Feeds**: Subscribe to private RSS feeds (Patreon, premium podcasts). Credentials stored securely on-device.
- **Local Accounts (Vault Mode)**: Use YourPods without a sync server for fully offline, on-device podcast management.
- **Custom gpodder.net Server Address**: Point at your own gpodder.net-compatible instance for self-hosted sync.


## Player & Audio

- **Native AVFoundation Audio Engine**: Built on AVAudioEngine for low-latency, reliable playback with Bluetooth, CarPlay, and Siri interruption recovery.
- **Live Transcripts**: Interactive transcripts with auto-scroll and in-transcript search with match navigation. Formats: SRT, VTT, JSON, plain text, HTML, Markdown, RTF.
- **Smart Chapters**: Chapters embedded in the audio file itself (ID3 CHAP in MP3, chapter atoms in MP4/M4A) are preferred over feed chapters because they stay aligned after dynamic ad insertion. Podcasting 2.0, RSS, and description-parsed chapters also supported. Chapter artwork follows playback on the player, lock screen, Control Center, and CarPlay.
- **Smart Queue**: Drag-and-drop reordering with "Now Playing" and "Up Next" sections, visible episode lengths.
- **Precision Control**: Granular playback speed (0.5×–3×) and custom sleep timers.
- **Skip Intro/Outro**: Configurable per-second precision (0–120s).
- **Mini Player**: Persistent playback controls across the app (NowPlayingBar).
- **Listening Stats**: Local listening history tracking.
- **Episode Activity**: Chronological played-episode list with progress, timestamp, and device. Sort by Recent or By Podcast.
- **Clear Queue**: One-tap clear from Up Next overflow menu with keep-current or stop-all options.
- **App Icon Badge**: Show unplayed episode count on the app icon.
- **Trim Silence**: Skip silent passages during playback.
- **AirPlay Picker**: Output-device picker in the mini player for AirPlay and Bluetooth routes.
- **Pause on Disconnect**: Playback pauses when headphones are unplugged or a Bluetooth/AirPlay device drops.

## Library & Browsing

- **Library Episodes View**: Switch the Library between Podcasts and Episodes — one flat episode list across every subscription, honouring the All / Downloaded / Unplayed / In Progress filters, arranged Newest First, By Date, or By Show.
- **Episode Search**: Library search covers episode titles across every subscription, with a Search Details option that extends it to episode descriptions and shows the matching snippet.
- **Episode Swipe Actions**: Assign Add to Queue, Play Next, Mark as Played, Hide, or Play Now to left and right swipe (Settings → Episode Swipe Actions).
- **Auto-Hide Unplayed Episodes**: Optionally hide unplayed episodes older than 7–90 days, on launch and every refresh, with a per-podcast override, a per-podcast log, and Undo All for 30 days. Downloaded and part-listened episodes are exempt.
- **Recently Updated**: Home section guarantees each podcast's newest episode a slot before a prolific show fills the rest; three-month window, configurable count (9–36, default 27), with a full All Recent Episodes list.

## Discovery

- **Unified Search**: Defaults to Apple Podcasts (iTunes) for extensive coverage, with optional PodcastIndex support (requires personal API key).
- **Add to Server**: Discover new podcasts in-app and instantly sync subscriptions to your self-hosted server.
- **Feed Cache**: Configurable cache duration (1–48 hours) for faster load times; pull-to-refresh bypasses cache.
- **Background Refresh**: Automatic episode fetching in the background with configurable intervals (15 min – 4 hours).

## Platform Integrations

- **CarPlay**: Full queue management, Recently Updated episodes tab, Now Playing with chapter navigation, playback speed and trim-silence controls. Artwork with placeholder loading.
- **Apple Watch**: Standalone playback, offline episode transfer, configurable podcast sync limit, complications showing playback status, true background audio with auto-advance, Recently Updated home screen, and watch-specific Wi-Fi-only download toggle.
- **Dynamic Island**: Real-time playback status via Live Activities on supported iPhones.
- **Siri & App Intents**: 32 Shortcuts actions — playback control, chapter navigation, sleep timer, downloads, queue management, bookmarking the current moment, share links, and value-returning actions (Get Current Episode, Get Queue, Get Podcasts, What's Next, Get Listening Stats, Get Share Link) that chain into automations. Ten of the 32 carry "Hey Siri" voice phrases — Apple caps `AppShortcutsProvider` at 10. Podcast parameters resolve against your library with an artwork picker rather than typed text.
- **VoiceOver**: Comprehensive accessibility support — custom rotor actions, adjustable seek bars, descriptive labels on every control, all localized.
- **Widgets & Complications**: Now Playing Home Screen widget in small, medium, and large — artwork, titles, progress with a live elapsed clock; play/pause and skip controls on medium and large; Up Next list on large. Plus Lock Screen widgets and watch face complications showing current playback, up next, and queue count.
- **Liquid Glass**: On iOS 26, the mini player, player controls, Home cards, search cards, and stat cards use Apple's Liquid Glass material. Glass Style setting (Settings → Appearance): Classic, Clear Glass, Glass, High Contrast Glass. Reduce Transparency and Increase Contrast override the choice. Pre-iOS 26 builds keep classic materials.

## Technical

- **Language**: Swift 5.10
- **UI Framework**: SwiftUI
- **Storage**: SwiftData
- **Audio**: AVFoundation / AVAudioEngine
- **Sync**: gPodder-compatible (Nextcloud gpodder-sync). Implements Open Podcast Sync protocol for subscriptions (SubscriptionDelta) and actions (EpisodeAction). Nextcloud Login Flow v2 for browser sign-in. Optional YourPods Cloud backend.
- **Localization**: String Catalogs (`.xcstrings`), English source, localized to de/es/fr/it/nl
- **Build System**: XcodeGen (`project.yml`) + Swift Package Manager (`Package.swift`)
- **Dependencies**: Firebase (Auth + App Check) and RevenueCat — used only to authenticate and entitle the optional YourPods Cloud account; unused on the gPodder, Nextcloud, and Vault Mode paths
- **Minimum Targets**: iOS 18.0, macOS 14.0, watchOS 10.0
- **Toolchain**: Xcode 26
- **Targets**: YourPods (iOS app), YourPodsMac (macOS app), YourPodsWatch (watchOS app), YourPodsWidgets (Now Playing widget, Live Activities, Lock Screen widgets), YourPodsComplication (watch complications), YourPodsTests (unit tests)

## Architecture

- `YourPods/YourPods/Audio/` — Audio playback engine (AudioManager: AVAudioEngine-based)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Models/` — SwiftData models (Podcast, Episode, ServerProfile, Chapter, EpisodeAction, PodcastSettings, Annotation)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Networking/` — gPodder API client (GPodderClient), RSS feed parser (RSSService), URL resolver, P3 tracker stripper (TrackingURLStripper)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Networking/Resources/` — Bundled OPAWG tracker-prefix snapshot and curated supplement (JSON)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Services/` — CarPlay, Live Activities, Transcripts, Watch connectivity, Downloads, Background Refresh, Listening Stats, OPML import/export, notes export (Markdown, Obsidian, Nextcloud Notes), share links, subscriptions
- `YourPods/YourPods/Services/Chapters/` — Embedded chapter extraction (ID3 CHAP, MP4/M4A chapter atoms) and chapter artwork
- `YourPods/YourPods/Services/Intents/` — App Intents, entities, and the Siri handler (replaces the former SiriIntents.swift)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Services/Sync/` — Sync orchestrators (gPodder, YourPods Cloud, Vault), playback reconciler, baseline store
- `YourPods/YourPods/State/` — Observable state managers: PlayerManager, PodcastManager, SettingsManager, NavigationState, SleepTimerManager
- `YourPods/YourPods/Views/` — SwiftUI views: Home, Library, Player, Queue, Notes, Settings, Search, History, Profile Selection, Downloads, Import, Episode Detail, Podcast Detail, and reusable Components (NowPlayingBar, ChapterListSheet, TranscriptListSheet, SleepTimerSheet, PodcastSettingsSheet)
- `YourPods/YourPods/Utilities/`, `YourPods/YourPods/Utils/` — Shared helpers and utility extensions
- `YourPodsWatch/` — watchOS app (standalone playback, library sync, remote player, episode browsing, sleep timer, playback speed)
- `YourPodsWidgets/` — Now Playing widget, Live Activities, and Lock Screen widgets
- `YourPodsComplication/` — watchOS complication widget
- `YourPodsTests/` — Unit tests

## Per-Podcast Settings

Each podcast can have individual settings (auto-queue mode, auto-download, remove after play, archive on complete) that override the global defaults.
